meta.records_are_evidence_not_output: Records are atomic evidence, not resume bullets. Generation combines, splits, or drops them per posting; it never emits them verbatim.
meta.authorship_verification_caveat: Records derived from commit activity can overstate ownership. Anything you did not personally design should say so in its own text — the generator honors that framing.
